description: This file defines the OrderDao interface which extends a generic DAO interface to handle data access operations for Order entities. It includes a method to list orders by store based on certain criteria.

classes.name: OrderDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to Order entities, extending generic DAO functionality.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders for a specific store based on the provided order criteria.
